impact_assessment.benefits: Only the rogue sees an execute window, and its hover range matches the actual bonus; other classes see the plain range; the engine's damage rule is unchanged
impact_assessment.risks: contract: renderer consumes player.hero_class for the marker/tooltip; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save/rule change; UI: renderer.js in the game-ui surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing source test before the fix (no heroClass gate); paladin/rogue hover captures at 60/200 HP; rogue damage selftest unchanged; inspector at three viewports; full gates

impact_assessment.benefits: Each boss owns its phase fiction: Choir splits into 2 even beside the vault/warden, foundry bosses escalate under their own name with no summons, Malakor keeps his summon/enrage
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Malakor blocks gain a type gate, other bosses gain seal-break/fury, Choir split searches rings 2-3 and retries; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save/RNG change; UI: engine.js in the game-ui surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing Choir split check (0 echoes, phase consumed); pack boss no-Malakor; Malakor still summons 2 and enrages; real seed 42 2F/3F wait turns before/after; source test; inspector at three viewports; full gates

impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing legend test before the fix; real three-step seed 42 before/after minimap capture; legend labels test; two consecutive inspector 75/75 runs; full gates
